questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: A combination of sand, salt, and water is an example of a ________.
questions.stemZh: 沙、盐和水的组合是 ________ 的一个例子。
questions.explanation: 沙不溶于水，体系不均匀，为 heterogeneous mixture（非均相混合物）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: A small amount of salt dissolved in water is an example of a ________.
questions.stemZh: 少量盐溶于水是 ________ 的一个例子。
questions.explanation: 少量盐完全溶解，体系均匀，为 homogeneous mixture（均相混合物）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which one of the following has the element name and symbol correctly matched?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪一项的元素名称与元素符号匹配正确？
questions.explanation: Fe=iron 正确。S 是 sulfur 不是 sodium；Tn 不是锡；N 是 nitrogen 不是 neon；B 是 boron 不是 bromine。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: In the following list, only ________ is not an example of a chemical reaction.
questions.stemZh: 下列各项中，只有 ________ 不是化学反应的例子。

options.text: dissolution of a penny in nitric acid
the formation of polyethylene from ethylene

questions.explanation: 水蒸气凝结只是物态变化，无新物质生成，不是化学反应；其余均生成新物质。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Gases and liquids share the property of ________.
questions.stemZh: 气体和液体共有的性质是 ________。
questions.explanation: 气体和液体都没有固定形状（indefinite shape），都会随容器改变形状。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Of the following, only ________ is a chemical reaction.
questions.stemZh: 下列各项中，只有 ________ 是化学反应。

options.text: dropping a penny into a glass of water

glossary.meaning: 失泽、失去光泽（表面生成新物质）

questions.explanation: 银失去光泽（tarnishing）生成 Ag2S，是化学反应；熔化、溶解、粉碎、投入水中均为物理变化。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: In the following list, only ________ is not an example of a chemical reaction.
questions.stemZh: 下列各项中，只有 ________ 不是化学反应的例子。

options.text: the production of hydrogen gas from water
the tarnishing of a copper penny

questions.explanation: 把木头劈成木屑只是物理破碎，无新物质生成，不是化学反应。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which of the following is (are) the lowest temperature?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个（些）温度最低？

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which calculation clearly shows a conversion between temperatures in degrees Celsius, °C, and temperature in Kelvins, K?
questions.stemZh: 哪个式子清楚地表示摄氏温度（°C）与开尔文温度（K）之间的换算？
questions.explanation: 摄氏与开尔文的换算：K = °C + 273.15。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Accuracy refers to ________.
questions.stemZh: 准确度（accuracy）指的是 ________。

options.text: how close a measured number is to zero
how close a measured number is to the calculated value
how close a measured number is to other measured numbers
how close a measured number is to the true value
how close a measured number is to infinity

optionsZh.B: 测量值接近计算值的程度
optionsZh.C: 测量值与其他测量值接近的程度
optionsZh.D: 测量值接近真实值的程度
optionsZh.E: 测量值接近无穷大的程度

glossary.meaning: 准确度（与真值的接近程度）
精密度（多次测量彼此接近程度）

questions.explanation: 准确度（accuracy）指测量值与真实值的接近程度；精密度才是测量之间彼此接近。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: ________ is the chemical symbol for elemental sodium.
questions.stemZh: ________ 是元素钠的化学符号。
questions.explanation: 钠的元素符号是 Na。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The SI unit for mass is ________.
questions.stemZh: 质量的 SI 单位是 ________。
questions.explanation: SI 质量单位是千克（kilogram），克不是基本单位。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: A one degree of temperature difference is the smallest on the ________ temperature scale.
questions.stemZh: 1 度的温度差在 ________ 温标上最小。
questions.explanation: 华氏温标的1度间隔最小（1 °F = 5/9 K < 1 K = 1 °C）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: A common English set of units for expressing velocity is miles/hour. The SI unit for velocity is ________.
questions.stemZh: 英文里常用“英里/小时”表示速度。速度的 SI 单位是 ________。
questions.explanation: SI 速度单位是 m/s。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The freezing point of water at 1 atm pressure is ________.
questions.stemZh: 在 1 atm 压力下，水的凝固点是 ________。
questions.explanation: 1 atm 下水的凝固点为 0 °C。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: "Absolute zero" refers to ________.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The symbol for the element phosphorus is ________.
questions.stemZh: 元素磷的符号是 ________。
questions.explanation: 磷的符号是 P；Pt 是铂，K 是钾。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The element hydrogen has the symbol ________.
questions.stemZh: 元素氢的符号是 ________。
questions.explanation: 氢的符号是 H；He 是氦。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which one of the following is a pure substance?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪一个是纯物质？
questions.explanation: 元素氧（O2）是纯物质；自来水、岩石、空气、苹果都是混合物。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The symbol for the element sodium is ________.
questions.stemZh: 元素钠的符号是 ________。
questions.explanation: 钠的符号是 Na；Hg 是汞，Sn 是锡，Pb 是铅。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Consider the following selected postulates of Dalton's atomic theory: (i) Each element is composed of extremely small particles called atoms. (ii) Atoms are indivisible. (iii) Atoms of a given element are identical. (iv) Atoms of different elements are different and have different properties. Which of the postulates is(are) no longer considered valid?
questions.stemZh: 考虑道尔顿原子论的以下几条假设：(i) 每种元素由称为原子的极小粒子组成；(ii) 原子不可再分；(iii) 同种元素的原子完全相同；(iv) 不同元素的原子不同、性质不同。哪些假设已不再成立？
questions.explanation: (ii)原子不可再分、(iii)同种元素原子完全相同，在现代理论中都不再成立（原子可再分；存在同位素）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Of the following, the smallest and lightest subatomic particle is the ________.
questions.stemZh: 下列中，最小最轻的亚原子粒子是 ________。
questions.explanation: 电子质量约 9.11×10⁻³¹ kg，是所列粒子中最小的。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: All atoms of a given element have the same ________.
questions.stemZh: 同种元素的所有原子都具有相同的 ________。
questions.explanation: 同种元素的原子质子数相同；中子数可不同（同位素），质量、密度也可不同。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: There are ________ electrons, ________ protons, and ________ neutrons in an atom of Xe.
questions.stemZh: 一个 ¹³²₅₄Xe 原子中有 ________ 个电子、________ 个质子、________ 个中子。

glossary.meaning: 同位素符号（左上角质量数，左下角原子序数）

questions.explanation: ⁵⁴¹³²Xe：质子数=原子序数=54，电子数=54，中子数=132−54=78。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The nucleus of an atom does not contain ________.
questions.stemZh: 原子核中不含有 ________。
questions.explanation: 原子核由质子和中子组成，不含电子。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The subatomic particles located in the nucleus with no overall charges are ________.
questions.stemZh: 位于原子核内、整体不带电的亚原子粒子是 ________。
questions.explanation: 中子（neutron）不带电，位于核内。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The atomic mass unit is presently based on assigning an exact integral mass (in amu) to an isotope of ________.
questions.stemZh: 目前的原子质量单位是以 ________ 的一种同位素被赋予精确整数质量（amu）为基准的。
questions.explanation: 原子质量单位以碳-12（¹²C）的 1/12 为基准定义。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: In the periodic table, the elements are arranged in ________.
questions.stemZh: 在周期表中，元素按 ________ 排列。
questions.explanation: 周期表按原子序数（核电荷数）递增排列。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Elements ________ exhibit similar physical and chemical properties.
questions.stemZh: ________ 的元素会表现出相似的物理和化学性质。

options.text: in the same period of the periodic table
on opposite sides of the periodic table
in the same group of the periodic table

questions.explanation: 同一族（group）元素化学性质相似。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The elements in groups 1A, 6A, and 7A are called ________, respectively.
questions.stemZh: 1A、6A、7A 族元素分别被称为 ________。

options.text: alkaline earth metals, halogens, and chalcogens
alkali metals, halogens, and noble gases
alkaline earth metals, transition metals, and halogens
halogens, transition metals, and alkali metals

optionsZh.A: 碱土金属、卤素、氧族元素
optionsZh.D: 碱土金属、过渡金属、卤素

questions.explanation: 1A 碱金属（alkali metals）、6A 氧族（chalcogens）、7A 卤素（halogens）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Elements in the same group of the periodic table typically have ________.
questions.stemZh: 周期表中同一族的元素通常具有 ________。

optionsZh.E: 相似的物理和化学性质

questions.explanation: 同族元素具有相似的物理和化学性质。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Of the choices below, which one is not an ionic compound?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个不是离子化合物？

glossary.meaning: 共价化合物（分子化合物）

questions.explanation: PCl5 是共价（分子）化合物，不是离子化合物；RbCl、PbCl2、NaCl 为离子化合物。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which one of the following compounds is copper(I) chloride?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个化合物是氯化亚铜（铜(I)氯化物）？
questions.explanation: 铜(I)为 Cu⁺，氯化亚铜是 CuCl。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which group in the periodic table contains only nonmetals?
questions.stemZh: 周期表中哪一族只含非金属？
questions.explanation: 8A 族（稀有气体）全部是非金属；6A 含类金属/金属，故不满足。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Horizontal rows of the periodic table are known as ________.
questions.stemZh: 周期表中横向的行称为 ________。
questions.explanation: 横向的行称为周期（periods）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Vertical columns of the periodic table are known as ________.
questions.stemZh: 周期表中纵向的列称为 ________。
questions.explanation: 纵向的列称为族（groups）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Elements in Group 8A are known as the ________.
questions.stemZh: 8A 族元素被称为 ________。
questions.explanation: 8A 族是稀有气体（noble gases）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Potassium is a ________ and chlorine is a ________.
questions.explanation: 钾是金属，氯是非金属。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Oxygen is a ________ and nitrogen is a ________.
questions.explanation: 氧和氮都是非金属。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The charge on the manganese in the salt MnF3 is ________.
questions.stemZh: 盐 MnF3 中锰的电荷是 ________。
questions.explanation: MnF3 中 F 为 −1×3=−3，故 Mn 为 +3。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Calcium forms an ion with a charge of ________.
questions.stemZh: 钙形成的离子的电荷是 ________。
questions.explanation: 钙位于 2A 族，失去 2 个电子形成 Ca²⁺。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Oxygen forms an ion with a charge of ________.
questions.stemZh: 氧形成的离子的电荷是 ________。
questions.explanation: 氧得到 2 个电子形成 O²⁻。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The correct name for Al2O3 is ________.
questions.stemZh: Al2O3 的正确名称是 ________。
questions.explanation: Al2O3 是离子化合物，命名 aluminum oxide（不用前缀）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The correct name for H2SO4 is ________.
questions.stemZh: H2SO4 的正确名称是 ________。
questions.explanation: H2SO4 是硫酸 sulfuric acid；H2SO3 才是 sulfurous acid。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Iron and chlorine form an ionic compound whose formula is FeCl3. The name of this compound is ________.
questions.stemZh: 铁与氯形成化学式为 FeCl3 的离子化合物，该化合物的名称是 ________。
questions.explanation: FeCl3 中 Fe 为 +3，命名 iron(III) chloride。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Copper and chlorine form an ionic compound whose formula is CuCl2. The name of this compound is ________.
questions.stemZh: 铜与氯形成化学式为 CuCl2 的离子化合物，该化合物的名称是 ________。
questions.explanation: CuCl2 中 Cu 为 +2，应命名 copper(II) chloride。选项 D 为 copper(II) dichloride（多前缀）、E 为旧称 cupric chloride。严格 IUPAC 应为 copper(II) chloride，选项中无完全对应。【本次AI=D，手机=E，有争议待老师确认】

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Of the following, the subatomic particle with the smallest mass is the ________.
questions.stemZh: 下列中，质量最小的亚原子粒子是 ________。
questions.explanation: 电子质量最小。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: 200 pm is the same as ________ Å.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The charge on the copper ion in the salt CuO is ________.
questions.stemZh: 盐 CuO 中铜离子的电荷是 ________。
questions.explanation: CuO 中 O 为 −2，故 Cu 为 +2。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The charge on the silver ion in the salt AgCl is ________.
questions.stemZh: 盐 AgCl 中银离子的电荷是 ________。
questions.explanation: AgCl 中 Cl 为 −1，故 Ag 为 +1。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Of the following, ________ radiation has the shortest wavelength.
questions.stemZh: 下列中，________ 辐射的波长最短。
questions.explanation: X 射线波长最短（远短于紫外、红外、微波、无线电波）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: According to the Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle, it is impossible to know precisely both the position and the ________ of an electron.
questions.stemZh: 根据海森堡不确定性原理，不可能同时精确知道电子的位置和它的 ________。
questions.explanation: 不确定性原理：无法同时精确知道电子的位置与动量（momentum）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which one of the quantum numbers does not result from the solution of the Schrodinger equation?
questions.stemZh: 哪一个量子数不是由薛定谔方程的解得到的？
questions.explanation: 自旋量子数 ms 不由薛定谔方程解出，而是相对论/实验引入。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The photoelectric effect is ________.

options.text: the total reflection of light by metals giving them their typical luster
the production of current by silicon solar cells when exposed to sunlight
the ejection of electrons by a metal when struck with light of sufficient energy
the darkening of photographic film when exposed to an electric field

optionsZh.A: 金属对光的全反射，使其呈现典型光泽
optionsZh.B: 硅太阳能电池受阳光照射时产生电流
optionsZh.C: 金属被能量足够的光照射时逸出电子
optionsZh.D: 照相底片暴露在电场中变暗

questions.explanation: 光电效应：金属被足够能量（频率）的光照射时逸出电子。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: All of the orbitals in a given electron shell have the same value as the ________ quantum number.
questions.stemZh: 同一电子层中的所有轨道具有相同的 ________ 量子数。
questions.explanation: 同一电子层（shell）内所有轨道主量子数 n 相同。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The uncertainty principle states that ________.
questions.stemZh: 不确定性原理指出 ________。

options.text: matter and energy are really the same thing
it is impossible to know anything with certainty
it is impossible to know the exact position and momentum of an electron
there can only be one uncertain digit in a reported number
it is impossible to know how many electrons there are in an atom

optionsZh.A: 物质与能量其实是同一回事
optionsZh.B: 不可能确定地知道任何事
optionsZh.C: 不可能知道电子的精确位置和动量
optionsZh.D: 报告的数字中只能有一位不确定数字
optionsZh.E: 不可能知道一个原子中有多少电子

questions.explanation: 不确定性原理指无法同时精确确定电子的位置和动量。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which one of the following orbitals can hold two electrons?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个轨道可以容纳两个电子？
questions.explanation: 每个轨道最多容纳 2 个电子，2px、3s、4dxy 都是轨道，故均可。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which of the subshells below do not exist due to the constraints upon the angular momentum quantum number?
questions.stemZh: 由于角动量量子数的限制，下列哪个亚层不存在？
questions.explanation: 4f、4d、4p、4s 均满足 n 与 l 的约束而存在，故没有不存在的。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: An electron cannot have the quantum numbers n = ________, l = ________, ml = ________.
questions.explanation: n=1 只允许 l=0，故 (1,1,1) 不可能存在。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which one of the following is an incorrect subshell notation?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个亚层符号是不正确的？
questions.explanation: 2d 不合法：n=2 时 l 最大为 1，不存在 d 轨道。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which of the following is not a valid set of four quantum numbers? (n, l, ml, ms)
questions.stemZh: 下列哪一组四个量子数 (n, l, ml, ms) 是不合法的？

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The lowest orbital energy is reached when the number of electrons with the same spin is maximized. This statement describes ________.
questions.stemZh: 当相同自旋的电子数达到最大时，轨道能量最低。这句话描述的是 ________。
questions.explanation: 描述 Hund 规则：同一能级电子尽量分占轨道且自旋平行。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which electron configuration represents a violation of the Pauli exclusion principle?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个电子排布图违反了泡利不相容原理？
questions.explanation: C 的 2s 轨道两个电子自旋相同（↑↑），违反泡利不相容原理（同一轨道两电子自旋必须相反）。A 是 2p 未填满就成对，违反洪特规则而非泡利；B、D、E 不违反泡利。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The ________ quantum number defines the shape of an orbital.
questions.stemZh: ________ 量子数决定轨道的形状。
questions.explanation: 角量子数（angular momentum，l）决定轨道形状。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The n = 1 shell contains ________ p orbitals. All the other shells contain ________ p orbitals.
questions.stemZh: n=1 电子层含有 ________ 个 p 轨道。其余电子层都含有 ________ 个 p 轨道。
questions.explanation: n=1 层没有 p 轨道（0 个）；n≥2 每层有 3 个 p 轨道。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: There are ________ orbitals in the second shell.
questions.stemZh: 第二电子层有 ________ 个轨道。
questions.explanation: 第二层含 2s(1)+2p(3)=4 个轨道。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: ________-orbitals are spherically symmetrical.
questions.stemZh: ________ 轨道呈球形对称。
questions.explanation: s 轨道呈球形对称。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: How many quantum numbers are necessary to designate a particular electron in an atom?
questions.stemZh: 确定原子中某个特定电子需要多少个量子数？
questions.explanation: 确定一个电子需 4 个量子数（n, l, ml, ms）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which one of the following represents an acceptable set of quantum numbers for an electron in an atom? (arranged as n, l, ml, and ms )
questions.stemZh: 下列哪一组是原子中电子可接受的量子数（按 n, l, ml, ms 排列）？

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: What wavelengths correspond to the visible region of the electromagnetic spectrum?
questions.stemZh: 可见光区对应电磁波谱的哪个波长范围？
questions.explanation: 可见光约 400–750 nm。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: In which set of elements would all members be expected to have very similar chemical properties?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪一组元素的所有成员预期具有非常相似的化学性质？
questions.explanation: O、S、Se 同属 6A 族，化学性质相似。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: In which set of elements would all members be expected to have very similar chemical properties?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪一组元素的所有成员预期具有非常相似的化学性质？
questions.explanation: Br、I、At 同属 7A 族（卤素），性质相似。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The effective nuclear charge of an atom is primarily affected by ________.
questions.stemZh: 原子的有效核电荷主要受 ________ 影响。
questions.explanation: 有效核电荷 Zeff = Z − 屏蔽常数；本次AI认为“主要受核电荷影响”（C），手机选“内层电子屏蔽”（A）。教材常强调内层电子的屏蔽作用，此题口径存疑。【本次AI=C，手机=A，有争议待老师确认】

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Atomic radius generally increases as we move ________.
questions.stemZh: 当我们 ________ 时，原子半径通常增大。

options.text: down a group and from right to left across a period
up a group and from left to right across a period
down a group and from left to right across a period
up a group and from right to left across a period
down a group; the period position has no effect

optionsZh.A: 沿族向下、沿周期从右向左
optionsZh.B: 沿族向上、沿周期从左向右
optionsZh.C: 沿族向下、沿周期从左向右
optionsZh.D: 沿族向上、沿周期从右向左
optionsZh.E: 沿族向下；周期位置无影响

questions.explanation: 原子半径向下（同族）增大、同周期自右向左增大。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Of the following, which gives the correct order for atomic radius for Mg, Na, P, Si and Ar?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个是 Mg、Na、P、Si、Ar 原子半径的正确顺序？
questions.explanation: 同周期半径：Na > Mg > Si > P > Ar（从左到右减小）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which isoelectronic series is correctly arranged in order of increasing radius?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个等电子体序列按半径递增排列正确？

glossary.meaning: 等电子体序列（电子数相同）

questions.explanation: 等电子体半径随核电荷增大而减小：Ca²⁺ < K⁺ < Ar < Cl⁻。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Of the choices below, which gives the order for first ionization energies?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个给出第一电离能的正确顺序？
questions.explanation: 第一电离能：Ar > Cl > S > Si > Al（同周期从左到右增大）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which equation correctly represents the first ionization of calcium?
questions.stemZh: 哪个方程式正确表示钙的第一电离？

glossary.meaning: 第一电离（失去第一个电子）

questions.explanation: 第一电离：Ca(g) → Ca⁺(g) + e⁻。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which of the following correctly represents the second ionization of copper?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个正确表示铜的第二电离？
questions.explanation: 第二电离：Cu⁺(g) → Cu²⁺(g) + e⁻。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Of the following elements, ________ has the most negative electron affinity.
questions.stemZh: 下列元素中，________ 的电子亲和能最负。
questions.explanation: Cl 的电子亲和能最负（同族自上而下减小，Cl 略大于 F）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which equation correctly represents the electron affinity of calcium?
questions.stemZh: 哪个方程式正确表示钙的电子亲和能？
questions.explanation: 电子亲和能：Ca(g) + e⁻ → Ca⁻(g)。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: In the generation of most anions, the energy change (kJ/mol) that _______ an electron is ________.
questions.stemZh: 在生成大多数阴离子的过程中，________ 一个电子所对应的能量变化（kJ/mol）是 ________。

options.text: None of the above is correct.

questions.explanation: 生成阴离子时加入电子，能量变化为放出，符号为负。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Of the elements below, ________ is the most metallic.
questions.stemZh: 下列元素中，________ 的金属性最强。
questions.explanation: 铯（cesium）在所列元素中金属性最强（同族向下增强）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Of the compounds below, ________ has the smallest ionic separation.
questions.stemZh: 下列化合物中，________ 的离子间距最小。
questions.explanation: KF 由半径最小的 K⁺ 与 F⁻ 组成，离子间距最小。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which ion below has the largest radius?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个离子半径最大？
questions.explanation: Br⁻ 半径最大（同族阴离子向下增大）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: ________ have the lowest first ionization energies of the groups listed.
questions.stemZh: 所列各族中，________ 的第一电离能最低。
questions.explanation: 碱金属第一电离能最低。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which of the following correctly represents the second ionization of phosphorus?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个正确表示磷的第二电离？
questions.explanation: 第二电离：P⁺(g) → P²⁺(g) + e⁻。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which of the following correctly represents the third ionization of aluminum?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个正确表示铝的第三电离？
questions.explanation: 第三电离：Al²⁺(g) → Al³⁺(g) + e⁻。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Of the following elements, ________ has the most negative electron affinity.
questions.stemZh: 下列元素中，________ 的电子亲和能最负。
questions.explanation: 所列元素中 S 的电子亲和能最负（O 因半径小电子排斥而略小）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Of the following species, ________ has the largest radius.
questions.stemZh: 下列粒子中，________ 的半径最大。
questions.explanation: Br⁻ 半径最大（36 电子，负电荷使半径增大）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which of the following correctly represents the electron affinity of phosphorus?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个正确表示磷的电子亲和能？
questions.explanation: 电子亲和能：P(g) + e⁻ → P⁻(g)。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Sodium is much more apt to exist as a cation than is chlorine. This is because ________.
questions.stemZh: 钠比氯更容易以阳离子形式存在。这是因为 ________。

options.text: chlorine is a gas and sodium is a solid
chlorine has a greater electron affinity than sodium does
chlorine has a greater ionization energy than sodium does
chlorine is more metallic than sodium

optionsZh.B: 氯的电子亲和能比钠大

questions.explanation: Cl 电离能很大、不易失电子成阳离子，而 Na 电离能小易成 Na⁺。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Of the elements below, ________ has the highest melting point.
questions.stemZh: 下列元素中，________ 的熔点最高。
questions.explanation: Fe 的熔点最高（金属键强）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Of the following oxides, ________ is the most acidic.
questions.stemZh: 下列氧化物中，________ 的酸性最强。
questions.explanation: CO2 是非金属氧化物，呈酸性；其余为金属氧化物呈碱性。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Which of the following is not a characteristic of metals?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪项不是金属的特征？

options.text: These are all characteristics of metals.

questions.explanation: 金属氧化物通常呈碱性而非酸性，故“acidic oxides”不是金属特性。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The element in the periodic table that looks like a metal, is a poor thermal conductor, and acts as an electrical semiconductor is ________.
questions.stemZh: 周期表中看起来像金属、导热性差、且作为半导体导电的元素是 ________。
questions.explanation: 硅（Si）有金属光泽、导热性差、是半导体。【Si/Ge 均符合描述，答案待核】

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Metals can be ________ at room temperature.
questions.stemZh: 金属在室温下可以是 ________。
questions.explanation: 金属在室温下可以是固体或液体（如汞）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: The first ionization energies of the elements ________ as you go from left to right across a period of the periodic table, and ________ as you go from the bottom to the top of a group in the table.
questions.stemZh: 元素的第一电离能沿周期表从左到右 ________，沿同族从下到上 ________。

options.text: The first ionization energies of the elements are completely unpredictable.

glossary.term: from the bottom to the top

questions.explanation: 同周期自左向右电离能增大；同族自下向上电离能增大。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: In general, as you go across a period in the periodic table from left to right: (1) the atomic radius ________; (2) the electron affinity becomes ________ negative; and (3) the first ionization energy ________.
questions.stemZh: 一般地，沿周期表从左到右：(1) 原子半径 ________；(2) 电子亲和能变得 ________ 负；(3) 第一电离能 ________。
questions.explanation: 自左向右：原子半径减小；电子亲和能变得更负（increasingly negative）；第一电离能增大。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Atom Questions)
questions.label: chapter1a
questions.stem: Most of the elements on the periodic table are ________.
questions.stemZh: 周期表中大多数元素是 ________。
questions.explanation: 周期表中大多数元素是金属。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Which of the following has eight valence electrons?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个具有8个价电子？
questions.explanation: Ti⁴⁺=[Ar]（第三层8电子）、Kr（稀有气体8）、Cl⁻（8）、Na⁺（Ne 构型8），四者都是8价电子，故选 E“以上都是”。【手机给 B、D 两个，遗漏 Ti⁴⁺、Cl⁻；且本题为单选，手机不严谨】

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Which of the following does not have eight valence electrons?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个不具有8个价电子？

options.text: All of the above have eight valence electrons.

questions.explanation: Ca⁺ 价层只剩1个电子，不是8电子；Rb⁺、Xe、Br⁻ 均为8，故选 A。【手机给 A、D，其中 D=Br⁻ 实为8电子，手机有误】

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Lattice energy is ________.

options.text: the energy required to convert a mole of ionic solid into its constituent ions in the gas phase
the energy given off when gaseous ions combine to form one mole of an ionic solid
the energy required to produce one mole of an ionic compound from its constituent elements in their standard states
the sum of ionization energies of the components in an ionic solid
the sum of electron affinities of the components in an ionic solid

optionsZh.A: 把1 mol 离子固体转化为气态组成离子所需的能量
optionsZh.B: 气态离子结合成1 mol 离子固体时放出的能量
optionsZh.C: 由组成元素的标准态生成1 mol 离子化合物所需的能量
optionsZh.D: 离子固体中各组分电离能之和
optionsZh.E: 离子固体中各组分电子亲和能之和

questions.explanation: 晶格能定义为把1 mol 离子晶体完全拆成气态离子所需的能量（A）；B 是逆过程放出的能量。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: In ionic bond formation, the lattice energy of ions ________ as the magnitude of the ion charges _______ and the radii ________.
questions.stemZh: 在离子键形成中，随着离子电荷量 ________、半径 ________，离子的晶格能 ________。
questions.explanation: 电荷越大、离子半径越小，晶格能越大：故 increases, increase, decrease。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The ability of an atom in a molecule to attract electrons is best quantified by the ________.
questions.stemZh: 分子中原子吸引电子的能力最好用 ________ 来量化。
questions.explanation: 电负性（electronegativity）衡量分子中原子吸引电子的能力。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: In the nitrite ion (NO2), ________.
questions.stemZh: 在亚硝酸根离子（NO₂⁻）中，________。

options.text: one bond is a double bond and the other is a  single bond

optionsZh.C: 一个键是双键、另一个是单键

questions.explanation: NO₂⁻ 两个 N–O 键因共振完全等同，键级相同（各约1.5），故两键相同。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The oxidation number of iron in Fe2O3 is ________.
questions.stemZh: Fe2O3 中铁的氧化数是 ________。
questions.explanation: O 为 −2×3=−6，Fe₂O₃ 中 Fe 为 +3。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The Lewis structure of the CO32- ion is ________.
questions.stemZh: CO₃²⁻ 离子的 Lewis 结构是 ________。
questions.explanation: CO₃²⁻ 正确结构：一个 C=O 和两个 C–O⁻，所有原子满足8电子；单键 O 各有3对孤对，双键 O 有2对。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Bond enthalpy is ________.
questions.explanation: 键焓定义为断开1 mol 化学键所需能量，恒为正值。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Of the bonds C-C, C=C, and C≡C, the C-C bond is ________.
questions.stemZh: 在 C–C、C=C、C≡C 三种键中，C–C 键 ________。

options.text: intermediate in both strength and length

questions.explanation: C–C 单键键级最低，最弱、最长。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: As the number of covalent bonds between two atoms increases, the distance between the atoms ________ and the strength of the bond between them ________.
questions.stemZh: 随着两原子间共价键数目增加，原子间距离 ________，键的强度 ________。
questions.explanation: 共价键数目越多（键级越高），键长越短、键能越大。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Based on the octet rule, magnesium most likely forms a ________ ion.
questions.stemZh: 根据八隅体规则，镁最可能形成 ________ 离子。
questions.explanation: Mg 失去2个电子形成 Mg²⁺ 达到 Ne 8电子构型。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Based on the octet rule, aluminum most likely forms an ________ ion.
questions.stemZh: 根据八隅体规则，铝最可能形成 ________ 离子。
questions.explanation: Al 失去3个电子形成 Al³⁺ 达到 Ne 构型。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: For a given arrangement of ions, the lattice energy increases as ionic radius ________ and as ionic charge ________.
questions.stemZh: 对给定的离子排列，离子半径 ________、离子电荷 ________ 时晶格能增大。
questions.explanation: 晶格能随离子半径减小而增大、随电荷增大而增大。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Elements from opposite sides of the periodic table tend to form ________.
questions.stemZh: 周期表两侧的元素倾向于形成 ________。

options.text: compounds that are gaseous at room temperature
covalent compounds that are gaseous at room temperature

optionsZh.C: 室温下为气态的化合物
optionsZh.E: 室温下为气态的共价化合物

questions.explanation: 周期表两侧（金属与非金属）之间易发生电子转移，形成离子化合物。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: A ________ covalent bond between the same two atoms is the longest.
questions.stemZh: 同样两个原子之间，________ 共价键最长。

options.text: They are all the same length.

questions.explanation: 同一对原子间，单键键长最长。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: A double bond consists of ________ pairs of electrons shared between two atoms.
questions.stemZh: 双键由两个原子间共用的 ________ 对电子构成。
questions.explanation: 双键由2对共用电子构成。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: What is the maximum number of double bonds that a hydrogen atom can form?
questions.stemZh: 一个氢原子最多能形成多少个双键？
questions.explanation: 氢只有1个价电子，最多形成1个单键，不能形成双键。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Electronegativity ________ from left to right within a period and ________ from top to bottom within a group.
questions.stemZh: 电负性在周期内从左到右 ________，在族内从上到下 ________。
questions.explanation: 电负性同周期自左向右增大，同族自上而下减小。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The formal charge on carbon in the molecule below is ________. 
questions.stemZh: 下图中碳的形式电荷是 ________。
questions.explanation: 图中分子为 CO₂（O=C=O），碳形式电荷 = 4 − (0 孤对 + 4 键) = 0。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: There are ________ unpaired electrons in the Lewis symbol for an oxygen atom.
questions.stemZh: 氧原子的 Lewis 符号中有 ________ 个未成对电子。
questions.explanation: 氧原子价电子2s²2p⁴，Lewis 符号中有2个未成对电子。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The oxide of which of the following metals should have the greatest lattice energy?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪种金属的氧化物晶格能最大？
questions.explanation: 电荷相同（+2）时离子半径越小晶格能越大；Be²⁺ 半径最小，故 BeO 晶格能最大。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: How many single covalent bonds must a chlorine atom form to have a complete octet in its valence shell?
questions.stemZh: 氯原子必须形成多少个单共价键才能使其价层达到完整八隅体？
questions.explanation: Cl 有7个价电子，只需形成1个单键即可补齐8电子。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Of the atoms below, ________ is the most electronegative.
questions.stemZh: 下列原子中，________ 的电负性最大。
questions.explanation: 同族自上而下电负性减小，Be 在所列元素中位置最高，电负性最大。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The oxidation number of phosphorus in PF5 is ________.
questions.stemZh: PF5 中磷的氧化数是 ________。
questions.explanation: PF₅ 中 F 为 −1×5=−5，P 为 +5。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The basis of the VSEPR model of molecular bonding is ________.
questions.stemZh: 分子成键的 VSEPR 模型的基础是 ________。

options.text: regions of electron density on an atom will organize themselves so as to maximize s-character
regions of electron density in the valence shell of an atom will arrange themselves so as to maximize overlap
atomic orbitals of the bonding atoms must overlap for a bond to form
electron domains in the valence shell of an atom will arrange themselves so as to minimize repulsions
hybrid orbitals will form as necessary to, as closely as possible, achieve spherical symmetry

optionsZh.A: 原子上的电子密度区域会自行组织以最大化 s 成分
optionsZh.B: 原子价层的电子密度区域会排列以最大化轨道重叠
optionsZh.C: 成键原子的原子轨道必须重叠才能成键
optionsZh.D: 原子价层中的电子域会排列以最小化排斥
optionsZh.E: 会按需形成杂化轨道以尽可能接近球形对称

questions.explanation: VSEPR 模型：价层电子域尽可能相互远离以最小化排斥。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: An electron domain consists of ________. <w:t>a) a nonbonding pair of electrons <w:t>b) a single bond <w:t>c) a multiple bond
questions.stemZh: 一个电子域由 ________ 构成。a) 一对孤对电子；b) 一个单键；c) 一个多重键。
questions.explanation: 电子域包括孤对电子、单键、多重键，三者都算一个电子域。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The molecular geometry consists of ________. <w:t>a) a nonbonding pair of electrons <w:t>b) a single bond <w:t>c) a multiple bond
questions.stemZh: 分子几何由 ________ 构成。a) 一对孤对电子；b) 一个单键；c) 一个多重键。
questions.explanation: 分子几何只由成键原子（单键与多重键）的排列决定，不含孤对电子。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: A molecule has the formula AB3 and the central atom is in a different plane from the surrounding three atoms. Its molecular shape is ________.
questions.stemZh: 某分子式为 AB3，其中心原子与周围三个原子不在同一平面。它的分子形状是 ________。
questions.explanation: AB₃ 且中心与三个原子不在同一平面，说明中心还有1对孤对，为三角锥形。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The molecular geometry of the PF3 molecule is ________, and this molecule is ________.
questions.stemZh: PF3 分子的分子几何是 ________，该分子是 ________。
questions.explanation: PF₃ 中心 P 有1对孤对，三角锥形；键有极性且不对称，分子极性（polar）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: For molecules with only one central atom, how many lone pairs on the central atom guarantees molecular polarity?
questions.stemZh: 对于只有一个中心原子的分子，中心原子上有几对孤对电子就保证分子有极性？
questions.explanation: 只有一个中心原子时，1对孤对必然使键的极性无法抵消，保证分子有极性。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The sp2 atomic hybrid orbital set accommodates ________ electron domains.
questions.stemZh: sp² 杂化轨道组容纳 ________ 个电子域。
questions.explanation: sp² 杂化对应3个电子域（三个杂化轨道）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The hybridization scheme for BeF2 is ________.
questions.stemZh: BeF2 的杂化方式是 ________。
questions.explanation: BeF₂ 直线形，Be 为 sp 杂化。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: When four atomic orbitals are mixed to form hybrid orbitals, how many hybrid orbitals are formed?
questions.stemZh: 当四个原子轨道混合形成杂化轨道时，会形成多少个杂化轨道？
questions.explanation: n 个原子轨道混合生成 n 个杂化轨道，4个→4个。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Valence bond theory does not address the issue of ________.
questions.stemZh: 价键理论不涉及 ________ 的问题。
questions.explanation: 价键理论不讨论分子的激发态；它解释成键、形状、杂化、多重键。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: A typical double bond ________.

options.text: is stronger and shorter than a single bond
consists of one σ bond and one π bond
consists of two shared electron pairs
All of the above answers are correct.

optionsZh.B: 由1个 σ 键和1个 π 键组成

questions.explanation: 双键比单键更强更短、含1个σ+1个π、由2对电子构成并使分子刚性，全对。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Electrons in ________ bonds remain localized between two atoms. Electrons in ________ bonds can become delocalized between more than two atoms.
questions.stemZh: ________ 键中的电子定域在两个原子之间；________ 键中的电子可离域到两个以上原子之间。
questions.explanation: σ键电子定域在两原子间；π键电子可离域到两个以上原子。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The bond order of any molecule containing equal numbers of bonding and antibonding electrons is ________.
questions.stemZh: 任何成键电子数与反键电子数相等的分子，其键级是 ________。
questions.explanation: 键级=(成键电子−反键电子)/2，两者相等时键级为0。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: In comparing the same two atoms bonded together, the ________ the bond order, the ________ the bond length, and the ________ the bond energy.
questions.stemZh: 比较同样的两个原子成键时，键级越 ________，键长越 ________，键能越 ________。
questions.explanation: 键级越大→键长越短、键能越大。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Based on molecular orbital theory, there is/are ________ unpaired electron(s) in the OF+ ion.
questions.stemZh: 根据分子轨道理论，OF⁺ 离子中有 ________ 个未成对电子。
questions.explanation: OF⁺ 有12个价电子，与 O₂ 等电子，π* 轨道上有2个未成对电子。【独立复算，待核】

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: For a molecule with the formula AB2, the molecular shape is ________.
questions.stemZh: 对于分子式为 AB2 的分子，其分子形状是 ________。
questions.explanation: AB₂ 若中心无孤对为直线形，有孤对为弯曲形，故 linear or bent。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The molecular geometry of the CHCl3 molecule is ________.
questions.stemZh: CHCl3 分子的分子几何是 ________。
questions.explanation: CHCl₃ 中心 C 有4个键、无孤对，四面体形。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The O-S-O bond angle in SO2 is slightly less than ________.
questions.stemZh: SO2 中 O–S–O 键角略小于 ________。
questions.explanation: SO₂ 中心 S 有1对孤对，O–S–O 键角略小于120°。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The hybridization of orbitals on the central atom in a molecule is sp. The electron-domain geometry around this central atom is ________.
questions.stemZh: 某分子中心原子轨道的杂化方式为 sp。该中心原子周围的电子域几何是 ________。
questions.explanation: sp 杂化对应电子域几何为直线形（linear）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: ClF3 has "T-shaped" geometry. There is/are ________ non-bonding domain(s) in this molecule.
questions.stemZh: ClF3 具有“T 形”几何。该分子中有 ________ 个非成键电子域。
questions.explanation: ClF₃ 中心 Cl 有5个电子域（3成键+2孤对），孤对2个，呈T形。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The H-C-H bond angle in the CH4 ion is approximately ________.
questions.stemZh: CH4 中 H–C–H 键角约为 ________。
questions.explanation: CH₄ 为正四面体，H–C–H 键角约109.5°。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The central atom in the ICl4- ion has ________ nonbonded electron pair(s) and ________ bonded electron pair(s) in its valence shell.
questions.stemZh: ICl4⁻ 离子的中心原子在价层中有 ________ 对非键电子、________ 对成键电子。
questions.explanation: ICl₄⁻ 为 AX₄E₂（方形平面），中心 I 有 2 对孤对 + 4 个成键电子对，故选 C（2,4）。【手机选 B(0,4)，忽略了2对孤对，手机有误】

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The central atom in the O3 molecule has ________ nonbonded electron pair(s) and ________ bonded electron pair(s) in its valence shell.
questions.stemZh: O3 分子的中心原子在价层中有 ________ 对非键电子、________ 对成键电子。
questions.explanation: O₃ 中心 O 有1对孤对、3对成键电子（1个双键+1个单键）。【计法待核】

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: According to VSEPR theory, if there are three electron domains in the valence shell of an atom, they will be arranged in a(n) ________ geometry.
questions.stemZh: 根据 VSEPR 理论，若原子价层有3个电子域，它们将排成 ________ 几何。
questions.explanation: 3个电子域的电子域几何应为“平面三角形（trigonal planar）”，但选项未列出该答案，题目选项可能有误，暂挂争议。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Using the VSEPR model, the electron-domain geometry of the central atom in XeF4 is ________.
questions.stemZh: 用 VSEPR 模型，XeF4 中心原子的电子域几何是 ________。
questions.explanation: XeF₄ 中心 Xe 有6个电子域（4键+2孤对），电子域几何为八面体。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Crystalline solids ________.

options.text: exist only at very low temperatures

questions.explanation: 晶体固体中粒子具有高度有序的长程排列。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: In liquids, the attractive intermolecular forces are ________.
questions.stemZh: 在液体中，分子间吸引力 ________。

options.text: very weak compared with kinetic energies of the molecules
strong enough to hold molecules relatively close together
strong enough to keep the molecules confined to vibrating about their fixed lattice points
not strong enough to keep molecules from moving past each other
strong enough to hold molecules relatively close together but not strong enough to keep molecules from moving past each other

optionsZh.A: 与分子动能相比非常弱
optionsZh.B: 强到足以使分子相对靠近
optionsZh.C: 强到足以使分子只能在固定晶格点附近振动
optionsZh.D: 弱到不足以阻止分子互相滑过
optionsZh.E: 强到足以使分子相对靠近，但弱到不足以阻止分子互相滑过

questions.explanation: 液体分子间作用力足以让分子靠拢，但不足以阻止分子相互滑动。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: A gas is ________ and assumes ________ of its container, whereas a liquid is ________ and assumes ________ of its container.

options.text: compressible, the volume and shape, not compressible, the shape of a portion
compressible, the shape, not compressible, the volume and shape
compressible, the volume and shape, compressible, the volume
condensed, the volume and shape, condensed, the volume and shape
condensed, the shape, compressible, the volume and shape

optionsZh.A: 可压缩，体积和形状；不可压缩，所在一部分的形状
optionsZh.B: 可压缩，形状；不可压缩，体积和形状
optionsZh.C: 可压缩，体积和形状；可压缩，体积
optionsZh.D: 凝聚，体积和形状；凝聚，体积和形状
optionsZh.E: 凝聚，形状；可压缩，体积和形状

questions.explanation: 气体可压缩并充满容器体积和形状；液体不可压缩、只取所在一部分的形状。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Which statement is true about liquids but not true about solids?
questions.stemZh: 关于液体成立、而关于固体不成立的说法是哪个？

options.text: They flow and are highly ordered.
They are highly ordered and not compressible.
They assume both the volume and the shape of their containers.
They flow and are not compressible.

optionsZh.B: 它们高度有序且不可压缩
optionsZh.D: 它们呈现容器的体积和形状

questions.explanation: 液体能流动且不可压缩，这是固体没有的性质。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The ease with which the charge distribution in a molecule can be distorted by an external electrical field is called the ________.
questions.stemZh: 分子中电荷分布被外电场扭曲的难易程度称为 ________。
questions.explanation: 极化率（polarizability）指电荷分布在外电场下可被扭曲的难易。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Hydrogen bonding is a special case of ________.
questions.stemZh: 氢键是 ________ 的一种特殊情形。
questions.explanation: 氢键是偶极–偶极作用的一种特殊情形。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: What intermolecular force is responsible for the fact that ice is less dense than liquid water?
questions.stemZh: 冰的密度小于液态水，是哪种分子间力造成的？
questions.explanation: 冰中氢键形成开放结构，使冰的密度小于液态水。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Which statements about viscosity are true? (i)<w:t>Viscosity increases as temperature decreases. (ii)<w:t>Viscosity increases as molecular weight increases. (iii)<w:t>Viscosity increases as intermolecular forces increase.
questions.stemZh: 关于黏度哪些说法正确？(i) 温度降低，黏度增大；(ii) 分子量增大，黏度增大；(iii) 分子间力增大，黏度增大。
questions.explanation: 黏度随温度降低、分子量增大、分子间力增大而增大，三条都对。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Viscosity is ________.

options.text: the "skin" on a liquid surface caused by intermolecular attraction

optionsZh.A: 由分子间吸引在液面形成的“表层”

questions.explanation: 黏度即流动的阻力（resistance to flow）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Large intermolecular forces in a substance are manifested by ________.
questions.stemZh: 物质中较大的分子间力表现为 ________。

options.text: high heats of fusion and vaporization

questions.explanation: 分子间力大→低蒸气压、高沸点、高熔化/汽化热、高临界温度压力，全对。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Of the following, ________ is an exothermic process.
questions.stemZh: 下列中，________ 是放热过程。

options.text: All of the above are exothermic.

questions.explanation: 凝固是放热过程（exothermic）；熔化、升华、沸腾均为吸热。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: A volatile liquid is one that ________.
questions.stemZh: 易挥发液体是 ________ 的液体。
questions.explanation: 挥发性液体易蒸发（readily evaporates）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: In general, the vapor pressure of a substance increases as ________ increases.
questions.stemZh: 一般来说，物质的蒸气压随 ________ 增大而增大。
questions.explanation: 温度升高，蒸气压增大。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Volatility and vapor pressure are ________.
questions.stemZh: 挥发性与蒸气压 ________。
questions.explanation: 挥发性与蒸气压正相关（directly proportional）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Which one of the following should have the lowest boiling point?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个沸点最低？
questions.explanation: CH₄ 只有弱色散力，沸点最低。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Of the following substances, ________ has the highest boiling point.
questions.stemZh: 下列物质中，________ 的沸点最高。
questions.explanation: H₂O 有氢键，沸点最高。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: What is the predominant intermolecular force in HCN?
questions.stemZh: HCN 中最主要的分子间力是什么？
questions.explanation: HCN 中 H 连在 C 上（非 N/O/F），无氢键；分子有极性，主要为偶极–偶极作用。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Ethanol melts at -114 °C and boils at 78 °C at a constant pressure of 1 atm. What state of matter must a sample of ethanol be in at 0 °C and 1 atm?
questions.stemZh: 乙醇在1 atm 下熔点 −114 °C、沸点 78 °C。0 °C、1 atm 时乙醇样品必须处于什么状态？
questions.explanation: 0 °C 介于乙醇熔点(−114 °C)与沸点(78 °C)之间，为液态。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Of the following, ________ is the least volatile.
questions.stemZh: 下列中，________ 最难挥发。
questions.explanation: CI₄ 分子量最大、色散力最强，最难挥发。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: A solid has a very high melting point, great hardness, and poor electrical conduction. This is a(n) ________ solid.
questions.stemZh: 某固体熔点很高、硬度很大、导电性差。这是一种 ________ 固体。
questions.explanation: 高熔点、高硬度、导电性差——共价网络固体。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Which of the following is not a type of solid?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个不是固体的类型？
questions.explanation: solid 类型不含“超临界”（supercritical），后者是流体状态。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Crystalline solids differ from amorphous solids in that crystalline solids have ________.
questions.stemZh: 晶体固体与非晶体固体的区别在于，晶体固体具有 ________。

options.text: a long-range repeating pattern of atoms, molecules, or ions
atoms, molecules, or ions that are close together
much larger atoms, molecules, or ions

optionsZh.B: 原子、分子或离子的长程重复图案
optionsZh.C: 彼此靠近的原子、分子或离子
optionsZh.D: 大得多的原子、分子或离子

questions.explanation: 晶体固体具有长程重复有序结构，非晶体没有。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The unit cell with all sides the same length and all angles equal to 90° that has lattice points only at the corners is called ________.
questions.stemZh: 所有边长相等、所有角等于90°、且只在顶角有格点的晶胞称为 ________。
questions.explanation: 三边等长、夹角90°、只在顶点有格点——简单立方（primitive cubic）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: What fraction of the volume of each corner atom is actually within the volume of a face-centered cubic unit cell?
questions.stemZh: 面心立方晶胞中，每个顶角原子实际有多少比例的体积位于晶胞内？
questions.explanation: 面心立方中顶角原子每个只贡献1/8到该晶胞。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: What portion of the volume of each atom or ion on the face of a unit cell is actually within the unit cell?
questions.stemZh: 晶胞面上每个原子或离子实际有多少比例位于晶胞内？
questions.explanation: 位于晶胞面上的原子，有一半在晶胞内（1/2）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: An alloy is a

options.text: metallic material that is composed of two or more elements.
nonmetal with some properties of a metal.
mineral containing two or more metals.

optionsZh.A: 两种金属的非均相混合物
optionsZh.C: 由两种或以上元素组成的金属材料
optionsZh.D: 具有某些金属性质的非金属
optionsZh.E: 含有两种或以上金属的矿物

questions.explanation: 合金是由两种或以上元素组成的金属材料。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Which one of the following is a property of most metals?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪项是大多数金属的性质？
questions.explanation: 大多数金属具有良好导热性。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Which statement about steel is false?
questions.stemZh: 关于钢，哪个说法是错误的？

options.text: It is an alloy of iron.
It can have different percentages of carbon.
It can be made so it resists rust.

optionsZh.C: 它可以含不同百分比的碳。

questions.explanation: 钢是铁合金，不是聚合物，故“It is a polymer”为假。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: What is the typical effect of the addition of an interstitial element on the properties of a metal?
questions.stemZh: 加入间隙元素对金属性质的典型影响是什么？

options.text: increase in malleability and corrosion resistance
increase in hardness and strength, decrease in ductility
decrease in melting point and increase in ductility
decrease in conductivity and increase in brittleness

optionsZh.A: 可锻性和抗腐蚀性提高
optionsZh.B: 硬度和强度提高、延展性下降

questions.explanation: 间隙元素使金属硬度、强度增大，延展性下降。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Alloys generally differ from compounds in that
questions.stemZh: 合金通常不同于化合物，因为 ________。

options.text: the former always contain some carbon.
the former always contain some iron.
the former always have semiconductor properties.
the atomic ratios of the constituent elements in the former are not fixed and may vary over a wide range.
the former never contain a transition element.

optionsZh.D: 前者组成元素的原子比不固定、可在很大范围内变化

questions.explanation: 合金与化合物的区别在于组成元素的原子比不固定、可在较大范围变化。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Metallic solids do not exhibit ________.
questions.stemZh: 金属固体不表现出 ________。
questions.explanation: 金属固体不会表现出极端脆性（extreme brittleness）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Which of the following is not a natural polymer?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个不是天然聚合物？
questions.explanation: 尼龙（nylon）是合成聚合物，不是天然聚合物。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: As a polymer becomes more crystalline, ________.
questions.stemZh: 随着聚合物结晶度提高，________。

options.text: None of the above is correct.

questions.explanation: 聚合物结晶度增大使熔点、密度、刚性、屈服应力升高，故所列四项均不对。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: ________ solids consist of atoms or molecules held together by dipole-dipole forces, London dispersion forces, and/or hydrogen bonds.
questions.stemZh: ________ 固体由靠偶极–偶极力、伦敦色散力和/或氢键结合的原子或分子组成。
questions.explanation: 分子固体靠偶极–偶极、色散力、氢键结合。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Blue LEDs are usually made of ________.
questions.stemZh: 蓝色 LED 通常由 ________ 制成。
questions.explanation: 蓝光 LED 常用氮化镓 GaN。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: CsCl crystallizes in a unit cell that contains a Cs+ ion at the center of a cube and a Cl- ion at each corner. The unit cell of CsCl is ________.
questions.stemZh: CsCl 的晶胞中，Cs⁺ 位于立方体中心、每个顶角有一个 Cl⁻。CsCl 的晶胞是 ________。
questions.explanation: Cs⁺ 在体心、Cl⁻ 在顶角，属体心立方（body-centered cubic）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The ________ lattice is one of the five two-dimensional lattices in which the lattice vectors a and b are equal and the γ angle between them is 90°.
questions.stemZh: ________ 晶格是五种二维晶格之一，其中晶格矢量 a 与 b 相等，两者夹角 γ 为 90°。
questions.explanation: 二维晶格中 a=b 且 γ=90° 的是正方晶格（square）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The ________ lattice is one of the seven primitive three-dimensional lattices in which the relationship between the lattice vectors a, b, and c can be written as: a ≠ b ≠ c
questions.stemZh: ________ 晶格是七种三维简单晶格之一，其晶格矢量满足 a ≠ b ≠ c。
questions.explanation: a≠b≠c 的选项中只有单斜（monoclinic）。原题若指“三边不等且均为90°”应为正交晶系，选项缺失，暂标争议。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Which of the following is not an alloy?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪个不是合金？
questions.explanation: 单质金（elemental gold）不是合金；其余均为合金。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Of the following, only ________ is not a polymer.
questions.stemZh: 下列中，只有 ________ 不是聚合物。
questions.explanation: 牙科汞合金（dental amalgam）是合金，不是聚合物。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The correct abbreviation for the polymer low-density polyethylene is ________.
questions.stemZh: 聚合物“低密度聚乙烯”的正确缩写是 ________。
questions.explanation: 低密度聚乙烯缩写为 LDPE。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Which element is typically not added to steel to modify its properties?
questions.stemZh: 通常不加入钢中来改性的元素是哪个？
questions.explanation: 钢中常加入 C、V、Cr、Ni 等；氮一般不是用来调节性能的典型添加元素。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Which property of metals cannot be explained with the electron-sea model?
questions.stemZh: 金属的哪种性质无法用电子海模型解释？
questions.explanation: 电子海模型能解释光泽、导电导热、延展性，但无法解释熔点变化趋势。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: NaCl crystallizes in a face-centered cubic cell. What is the total number of ions (Na+ ions and Cl- ions) that lie within a unit cell of NaCl?
questions.stemZh: NaCl 结晶为面心立方晶胞。NaCl 晶胞内共有多少个离子（Na⁺ 与 Cl⁻ 之和）？
questions.explanation: NaCl 面心立方晶胞含4个 Na⁺ 和4个 Cl⁻，共8个离子。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: An ionic solid, NaCl (s), dissolves in water because of the ________.
questions.stemZh: 离子固体 NaCl(s) 能溶于水，是因为 ________。

options.text: relatively low lattice energy due to small charges of Na+ and Cl- ions
simple face-centered cubic unit cell type it forms
1:1 ratio of ions in the unit cell
strong coulombic interactions between oppositely charged ions

optionsZh.A: 因 Na⁺、Cl⁻ 电荷小而使晶格能相对较低
optionsZh.B: 它形成的简单面心立方晶胞类型
optionsZh.D: 相反电荷离子间强的库仑作用

questions.explanation: Na⁺、Cl⁻ 电荷小、晶格能相对较低，水的溶剂化能足以将其拆开而溶解。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: CsCl crystallizes in a unit cell that contains the Cs+ ion at the center of a cube that has a Cl- at each corner. Each unit cell contains ________ Cs+ ion(s) and ________ Cl- ion(s), respectively.
questions.stemZh: CsCl 的晶胞中 Cs⁺ 位于立方体中心、每个顶角有 Cl⁻。每个晶胞分别含有 ________ 个 Cs⁺ 和 ________ 个 Cl⁻。
questions.explanation: CsCl 晶胞体心1个 Cs⁺、顶角8×1/8=1个 Cl⁻，故各1个。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: Inorganic compounds that are semiconductors have an average of ________ valence electrons.
questions.stemZh: 作为半导体的无机化合物平均有 ________ 个价电子。
questions.explanation: 无机半导体平均每个原子约4个价电子（如 Si、GaAs）。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: An elastomer will fail to regain its original dimensions following a distortion beyond its ________.
questions.stemZh: 弹性体在形变超过其 ________ 后，将无法恢复原有尺寸。
questions.explanation: 弹性体超过弹性极限（elastic limit）后无法完全恢复原状。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The formation of a condensation polymer generally involves ________.
questions.stemZh: 缩聚物的形成通常涉及 ________。

options.text: the mixing of sulfur with an addition polymer
the elimination of a small molecule

questions.explanation: 缩聚反应通常伴随小分子（如水）的消去。

questions.chapter: Chapter 1 Introduction of Chemistry and Matter (Bonding & Crystalline Q&A)
questions.label: chapter1b
questions.stem: The properties of graphene include ________.
questions.stemZh: 石墨烯的性质包括 ________。
questions.explanation: 石墨烯具有高强度与零能隙（高导电），热导率高而非低，故选 A and C。
